question: Across the exact same 169 complete no-movement pure-far recordings, how do public DTD occupancy and the frozen pre-AEC mic/reference ratio relate descriptively to an aligned scalar echo projection versus route/coherence and residual-energy observables, without treating any observable as a detector boundary or gain correction?

source.rating_formula: last half of each common-length mic+lpb clip

selection.rule: all GUIDs at the exact source revision that have both GUID_farend_singletalk_lpb.wav and GUID_farend_singletalk_mic.wav; exclude every with_movement file; no result-dependent filtering

provenance_limitations.statement: The pinned public tree exposes anonymous GUID mic/lpb WAV pairs but no per-GUID device, capture-gain, AGC, or hardware-chain sidecar metadata. Observable scalar coupling therefore cannot be labeled as hardware gain.

observation_method.predecessor_public_dtd_evidence: regenerate the frozen predecessor coverage result over the identical all-pair inventory using the unchanged read-only Activity probe
observation_method.route_delay_source: validation/tools/aec_route_ambiguity_probe.py raw numeric best_delay_samples over its first-3-second analysis window
observation_method.aligned_scale_fit: zero-intercept least-squares render-to-mic scalar over the official rating interval after applying the raw best delay
observation_method.aligned_coherence: squared normalized correlation over the same aligned official-rating samples
observation_method.aligned_residual: energy remaining after subtracting only the fitted scalar render projection; no signal is fed back into the pipeline
observation_method.scale_stability: repeat the same scalar fit independently on the two equal halves of the official rating interval and report descriptive dB delta
observation_method.case_level_association: Spearman correlation across all 169 cases, reported descriptively without thresholding, classification, significance gating, or candidate selection

outputs: regenerated predecessor public DTD and mic/reference ratio evidence
per-case raw route best delay, best score squared, runner-up score squared and peak ratio
per-case official-rating mic/render RMS ratio in dB
per-case aligned zero-intercept scalar magnitude in dB and sign
per-case aligned squared normalized correlation and scalar-projection residual energy fraction
per-case first-half versus second-half scalar magnitude and descriptive delta
cross-case distributions for scale, route, coherence and residual observables
case-level Spearman associations with public DTD occupancy and frozen smoothed-ratio evidence
prohibited_actions: infer or fabricate device identity, hardware gain, AGC state, microphone sensitivity, loudspeaker gain, or room transfer metadata that are not present upstream
apply the fitted scalar as gain normalization or echo correction
derive or search a DTD threshold
derive or search a gain-normalization constant
turn any correlation into a classifier, pass/fail boundary, ranking rule, or source-candidate selector
use route-probe historical large_route_candidate or large_route_ambiguous booleans
change DSP source, public DTD semantics, Activity/VAD thresholds, timers, or parameter values
revive I009 echo-normalized or residual-echo rescue
relax pure-far, movement, echo-path-change, Hosted Real AEC, or other qualification gates
promote to HIL, Product Certification, release, or shipping
interpretation_rule: The diagnostic may describe whether false-DTD occupancy co-varies with a stable aligned scalar projection, route/coherence observables, or residual energy in the pinned real corpus. Because upstream per-GUID device and capture-gain metadata are absent, the fitted scalar remains a combined observable of acoustic path, device chain and recording conditions and cannot be promoted to a hardware-gain cause or correction.
